guitar.notes: Hozier is commonly seen with Gibson acoustic guitars (e.g. J-45-style) live, and Telecasters for electric parts; reasonably documented but not singularly iconic.

tone.target: dark soul-rock crunch with warm mid bite
tone.profile: dark soul-rock crunch with warm mid bite
tone.summary: A vintage single-coil sound (P-90 emulation) running through a small British combo amp model (UK 50/AC30 style), utilizing an OD pedal for steady crunch and minimal fuzz for texture. EQ is used to enhance the mid-range bite, while Room reverb adds warmth without sounding too large.

rig.name: Hozier - Take Me To Church - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Provide steady, warm overdrive and crunch suitable for soul-rock.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is chosen over Blues OD/OD 9 to emulate the specific 'warm mid bite' required without sounding too aggressive or modern.

blocks.purpose: Add a subtle fuzz edge and grit without heavy distortion, complementing the Green OD.
blocks.gap: The Red Haze is used sparingly to provide texture/fuzz edge as requested, keeping it dialed back so it doesn't overpower the core tone.

blocks.purpose: Emulate a small British combo amp (Vox/AC30 style) for the required mid-forward, dry sound.
blocks.gap: The UK 50 model best captures the vintage, articulate character of a smaller British speaker cabinet.

blocks.purpose: Provide a classic British cabinet voicing that complements the UK 50 amp model.
blocks.gap: The Basket 4x12 offers a balanced, vintage sound suitable for soul-rock without being overly aggressive.

blocks.purpose: Boost the mid-range frequencies to achieve the required 'mid-forward vocal tone' and bite.
blocks.gap: Using EQ 2 allows for precise, targeted mid-boost without affecting the overall character of the amp/cab chain.

blocks.purpose: Placeholder for modulation. Disabled as per 'avoid' list and corrections.
blocks.gap: The Chorus module is included but explicitly disabled to adhere to the musical verdict's instructions (drop chorus/vibrato).

blocks.purpose: Add subtle warmth and space to the overall tone without sounding like a 'big delay' or overly ambient.
blocks.gap: Room reverb provides natural, contained ambience suitable for dark soul-rock.

blocks.purpose: Placeholder for delay. Disabled to avoid 'big delay' effect.
blocks.gap: The Digital Delay module is included but explicitly disabled to adhere to the musical verdict's instructions (avoid big delay).

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR to better capture vintage British cabinet realism.

proposals.reason: The current 4x12 is too generic; a single vintage 12-inch IR will better match the Vox/British combo vibe.
